craft_notes: Sthāyin: placement. Rows: courses laid. Read aloud: mapping tread.

lines: In power, deed is time's road; east and north
there letter-spell-word roads stand in time's road —
beyond the fine, the gross in form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra kriyā śaktau kālādhvā prācyabhāge uttare tu mūrtivaicitryarūpo deśādhvā tatra varṇamantrapadādhvanaḥ kālādhvani sthitiḥ parasūkṣmasthūlarūpatvāt
